run_RemoteLocobot_server: run the RemoteLocobot Pyro4 server with a given scene path and IP address
create_RemoteLocobot_instance: create a RemoteLocobot instance with a scene path, noisy mode, and human objects
test_connection_RemoteLocobot: test the Pyro4 connection to the RemoteLocobot server and verify it responds
go_to_absolute_RemoteLocobot: move the robot base to an absolute (x, y, yaw) position in the world frame
go_to_relative_RemoteLocobot: move the robot base to a relative (x, y, yaw) offset from its current pose
